explainer_content.short_definition: TRL-era pop where teen idols, boy bands, and vocal divas converged in video-countdown monoculture.
explainer_content.history_capsule: The lane covers the late-1990s moment when MTV visibility, mall-pop marketing, R&B vocal style, and producer-led hooks made pop feel unavoidable.
explainer_content.why_it_mattered: It maps the last pre-streaming monoculture where youth fandom, television, radio, and CD-era albums reinforced the same stars.
explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: The sound is glossy and direct, but the presentation is equally important: choreography, video identity, and highly repeatable choruses carry the signal.
